mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_file_group (file_group_id, entity_type, entity_id, site_id, site_code, download_auth, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip) VALUES (#{fileGroupId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{downloadAuth}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp})
mapper.select: SELECT file_group_id, entity_type, entity_id, site_id, site_code, download_auth, delete_yn, created_by FROM tb_file_group WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT file_group_id, entity_type, entity_id, site_id, site_code, download_auth, delete_yn, created_by FROM tb_file_group WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_file_group SET download_auth = #{downloadAuth}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId}
